commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Martin Satriano (Getafe) duly receives a yellow card.
90+5' Elche are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Elche seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Here comes a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Josan (Elche).
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Victor Chust as he is replaced by Buba Sangare (Elche).
85' That's the end of the game for Mario Martin, who is replaced by Veljko Birmancevic (Getafe).
84' Here is a change. Grady Diangana is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Cepeda (Elche).
84' A substitution has been made. Marc Aguado goes off and John Donald (Elche) comes on.
83' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Victor Garcia blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
81' German Valera (Elche) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
80' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
78' The referee can't ignore those comments and Martim Neto (Elche) sees a yellow card for bad language.
78' The attendance is 28371.
76' David Affengruber (Elche) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
75' Getafe players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
73' Mario Martin (Getafe) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Domingos Duarte and he is replaced by Abdel Abqar (Getafe).
71' Substitution. Luis Vazquez (Getafe) replaces Allan Nyom.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Adria Pedrosa (Elche) is brought on as a substitute for Andre Silva.
66' This is a yellow card! Andre Silva (Elche) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
64' It will be a corner kick for Elche.
64' Tete Morente (Elche) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
62' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gonzalo Villar (Elche) and blew his whistle.
60' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
60' Andre Silva (Elche) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
58' Matias Dituro (Elche) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
53' Substitution. Damian Caceres is replaced by Davinchi (Getafe).
52' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Mario Martin (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Elche are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45+2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Grady Diangana (Elche). Victor Garcia saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' German Valera (Elche) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
41' German Valera (Elche) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
39' Djene (Getafe) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
39' A pass from Andre Silva (Elche) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
38' The foul by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
31' Martin Satriano (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Mario Martin (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
30' A pass into the penalty area from Tete Morente (Elche) is intercepted by the defence.
28' Damian Caceres (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' 81:19 – the latest ball possession ratio.
26' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
24' Wasted opportunity. Grady Diangana (Elche) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
24' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Victor Chust (Elche) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Elche.
18' Grady Diangana (Elche) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Elche have a corner.
17' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

13' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
10' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Elche will have an opportunity.
9' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Damian Caceres (Getafe) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
7' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Victor Garcia.
